specification.title: The Rust Reference
specification.version: Live official table of contents and cited chapters retrieved 2026-10-31; edition-2021 fixtures; rustc 1.91.1 oracle is a separate tool version, not a pinned Reference revision

inventory.notes: 119 numbered TOC chapters/subchapters enumerated, including informational appendices. Per-rule decomposition and code migration remain incomplete. Unread chapter details link the official table of contents rather than asserting a reviewed rule. Existing no-code capability templates are explicit message_only entries. No pcc1, full core/alloc, Rust ABI compatibility or borrow-checker claim; experimental_rustc_checked is caller attestation only. Historical 33 absent-PATH reference inputs stay historical unrun. Current 136 metadata acceptance is not runtime differential. Followup bd7d58a4 executed72focused/669whole, adding six actual native rustc/std-observer comparisons without relabeling historical136. Readonly-loan48d340a4 qualified79focused/732whole with eight new unchanged-input actual native rustc comparisons. c41672/2 actual lifetime failure is retained; the invalid parameter-rebinding original is now a negative and a separate local-rebinding input supplies positive evidence.

features.title: Local nominal inherent associated functions and by-value methods
features.scope: Checked nongeneric/generic local record and enum impls; self/mut self, Self names, qualified calls, explicit full impl type arguments, declaration-checked non-Copy generic bodies, source-order one-time receiver evaluation and recursion via shared instance registry. Excludes reference receivers, autoderef/autoborrow, trait impls, coherence specialization, method-local generic parameters, arbitrary self types and reference/Drop runtime. Qualified only in host pcc0/self Linux x86-64, with actual unchanged-source native rustc1.91.1 differential; Darwin remains cross-emission only.

features.title: Bounded direct-call readonly references and shared receiver loans
features.scope: Readonly references to existing admitted places only as direct call operands, including &self method receivers and explicit (*p).field projections. Owning-local loans remain live across all later/nested arguments and forbid overlapping mutation or non-Copy movement. Incoming reference reborrows preserve captured pointer values while distinct inferred local reference slots may be rebound. No mutable references, stored local borrows, temporary lifetime extension, reference returns/aggregate storage, general region constraints or general borrow checker; reference formal reassignment is conservatively unimplemented. Extern-C references retain only separately qualified non-generic repr(C) integer-record shapes. Experimental rustc-checked flag remains caller attestation. Qualified pcc0/self Linux x86-64 runtime only; Darwin is cross-emission only.
